headline: Quiet Sunday as earlier news fades
body: No new events were scored on this Sunday. Every ending moved by less than 0.1 point as the effect of earlier announcements, such as the week's data-center protests and Xi's cooperation body, faded by about 0.01 each. Horizon Balance eased to 0.84, and the world factors were unchanged.
movers_note: No ending moved by 0.1 or more; the largest changes were -0.01 drifts in Benevolent Dictator, Protector God, Gatekeeper and Enslaved God from fading older news.
